name: tilelang-type-decorator
description: Language support for TileLang: inlay hints for buffer shapes, dtypes, and scopes.

tilelang.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter that has the tlsp package installed.

tilelang.enableInlayHints.description: Enable inlay hints for TileLang buffer allocations.

tilelang.serverArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the TileLang LSP server (e.g. --target c to set the default analysis target).

tilelang.serverEnv.description: Environment variables for the TLSP server process, merged over the inherited environment (the analyzer subprocess inherits them). The default enables TileLang data-race diagnostics; remove that entry to opt out. Custom entries replace the whole default object.
